description: Photovoltaic Power Production Dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Elissaios Sarmas, Nuno Matias (National Technical University of Athens). Short description of the two Excel Files: 1. PV Plants Datasets: PV production data from 9 PV plants situated in various regions of Portugal as provided from the non-profit organisation, Coopérnico. Data are presented in separate excel sheets, one for each PV plant, named under its serial number. Coverage: national (PT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
